# Case index

One line per case in the library, so a new case can say how it differs from every
case we have (design guide, 'Choosing a case') without opening any of them. The six
variety dimensions come from `metadata.library` in each case; a blank means the pack
has not stated it yet. Nothing here has been reviewed by a physician unless the pack's
SEED says so.
